description_en: Checks whether the versions of components are the latest versions by calling CheckComponentsVersion
description_zh: 调用CheckComponentsVersion检查组件的版本是否为最新版本
kebab_example: aliyun hbase check-components-version --cluster-id hb-t4naqsay5gn0000 --components HBASE,HADOOP --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckComponentsVersion

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The component to check. Valid values:

HBASE
HADOOP
PHOENIX
SOLR
THRIFT
parameters.help_zh:
要检查的组件：

HBASE
HADOOP
PHOENIX
SOLR
THRIFT
parameters.name: components
